description: Call before you recommend or swap an ingredient. Returns the profile of one ingredient from Foodbe's ingredient data as structured fields: category, allergens, swaps, storage, and carbon footprint. Nutrition numbers are not included. Every field comes from stored data, never from a model. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

name.description: The ingredient name, for example apple.

name: foodbe_ingredient
